products.name: Deepgram
products.note: Speech recognition API; real-time transcription; model customization; on-prem option

profile_text.body:
Deepgram is a voice AI company that provides speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent APIs aimed at enterprise customers. The company describes itself as "the industry's voice AI leader" and positions its platform around real-time performance, accuracy, and scale. Rather than requiring developers to assemble separate components, Deepgram combines speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and LLM orchestration into a single API, which it says reduces complexity, latency, and cost.

Among its products, Deepgram offers a speech recognition API with real-time transcription, model customization, and an on-premises deployment option. The company has also introduced Flux TTS, a text-to-speech model it describes as the first voice model that thinks before it speaks, maintaining tone, expression, and continuity across a conversation. Flux TTS was made available to build with for free through September 12th, with up to 45 concurrent streaming connections globally and 5 in EU and AU regions. The company has also announced an integration with Amazon Connect.

No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the held data for Deepgram.
